category: inference gateway, prepaid Grok API at half list price, one-time signup credit

free_tier.stated: a one-time $5 signup credit spent at 50% off list price, usable on chat, images and video; there is no recurring free tier
free_tier.notes: the terms page says the $5 welcome credit unlocks with the first payment, while the pricing page, the quickstart and the login page say it is spendable from signup; a first payment of $4.99 or more adds $5 more once per account

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.grokified.com/v1 with a gk_live_ or gk_test_ key; a first-party CLI and a VS Code extension exist
chaining: the signup credit then prepaid top-ups from $5 at the same 50% rate

limits.value: $5 signup credit, once; when the balance runs out a key gets 402 insufficient_quota
Grokified applies no rate limit of its own; a 429 means the shared upstream account is over its rate

binding_note: the $5 credit is the only free allowance and a zero balance returns 402

identity_cost.detail: the login page carries an email field; the Sep 17, 2026 changelog entry says no card is asked, stored or verified; image and video generation unlock on a first payment

reliability_note: 429 responses come from the shared upstream account and carry no reliable Retry-After; accounts flagged for abuse are suspended

evidence.quote: $5 in free credits on signup, ready to spend, at the same 50% rate.
evidence.proved: the pricing page states the $5 signup credit at 50% off
the pricing FAQ says sign-up needs no card

evidence.quote: The card requirement from Aug 28 is gone. Nothing on Grokified asks for a card to be stored or verified, and we no longer keep one.
evidence.proved: the Sep 17, 2026 changelog entry removes the card requirement

evidence.quote: Image and video generation now unlock on your first payment instead
evidence.proved: image and video generation unlock on a first payment

evidence.quote: There is no free tier beyond the signup credit
A `429 rate_limit_exceeded` has one source: the shared account behind Grokified is over its request or token rate for the moment.
evidence.proved: 429 comes from the shared upstream account

evidence.quote: The signup welcome credit is $5. It unlocks with your first payment and spends at the same 50% rate as any other usage.
evidence.proved: the terms page says the welcome credit unlocks with the first payment, which conflicts with the pricing page

evidence.quote: A brand-new key works on its signup credit straight away.
evidence.proved: the quickstart says a new key works on the signup credit
the login page carries an email field

notes: the card requirement of the Aug 28, 2026 changelog entry, with 20 free requests before the card, was reversed by the Sep 17, 2026 entry and is not a current term
